title: Morning Fog Advisory
description: Expect minor delays up to 5 minutes on the Coastal Connector due to reduced visibility.

title: Nightly Maintenance on S1

recommendedAlternatives: Use S2 Northbound Express as alternative route.

title: Skyline Loop Detour
description: Road construction near Skyline Commons. B2 buses are skipping Skyline Commons between 09:00 and 16:00.
recommendedAlternatives: Use B1 to Civic Center Hub and transfer to S1.

title: Aurora Line Delays
description: Signal issue near Innovation Park causing up to 20-minute delays on the Aurora Line.
recommendedAlternatives: Consider using S3 Tech Line for trips to Innovation Park.

title: Weekend Schedule Change
description: Innovation Shuttle (B4) running on reduced weekend schedule with 30-minute frequency.
